title: Three things that matter in good support
prompt: Let's use this skill: show me what you can do. (five interview clips of an Enable & Support manager)
voice: her own voice (interview audio), not Kokoro

music.source: none, by choice: her voice and the photo clicks only

slides.say: Can you give me three things that matter in good support? Gosh, I'm sure there's loads more than three.
Things that spring to mind would be treating people with kindness and with respect
Listening to people properly, but properly listening and understanding what they want and what they need.
and always promoting independence and choice. There are three that kind of come immediately to mind.
If you're not sure what we do, give us a ring, ask us, we'd be really happy to answer any questions you might have.

facts.speaker: Enable & Support team member in uniform (name not confirmed; the interviewer may call her Grace in a false-start clip)
facts.words: every word is hers (and the interviewer's question on slide 01), cut from the interview clips without rewording
